channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: LLVM Vulkan 1.1: Drop-in compiler passes (GVN, CSE, CFG, DCE) on Vulkan compute with benchmarks & Clang integration
item.description: Hey r/programming and r/Compilers , I've just released LLVM Vulkan 1.1 , an open-source project that moves beyond an experimental prototype into a drop-in pass plugin that accelerates LLVM middle-end passes using portable Vulkan compute… (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: Google Launches LiteRT Tensor API for Building, Customizing, and Optimizing ML Models for On-Device
item.description: Google has introduced the LiteRT Tensor API, a lightweight C++ API that allows developers to build, customize, and optimize machine learning models directly for on-device execution. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports copying option groups during cross-Region snapshot copy
item.description: Amazon RDS for Oracle now lets you copy the option group associated with a DB snapshot when you copy that snapshot to another AWS Region. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS announces AWS Interconnect - last mile preview with Equinix
item.description: AWS Interconnect - last mile is now available in preview with Equinix. You can connect your infrastructure across Equinix's global network of 282 data centers worldwide to AWS in a few clicks. (1 source: aws)

item.title: New features for Amazon EC2 Capacity Manager
item.description: Amazon EC2 Capacity Manager now offers real-time supportability checks and capacity fulfillment metrics. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon ECS Gateway Arrives with Generated Hostnames and No Custom Domain Support
item.description: AWS has released Amazon ECS Gateway, an account-level ingress resource letting platform teams define networking once and application teams opt services in with a connector. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon WorkSpaces for AI agents now supports Linux and Windows 11 cloud desktops
item.description: WorkSpaces for AI agents now supports Linux and Windows 11 cloud desktops, in addition to Windows Server. You can run each AI agent on the operating system that its workflows and applications require. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Article: The App Is Just the Tip: What It Takes to Build Mobile Infrastructure at Scale
item.description: What determines whether your app feels fast, ships often, and stays stable at scale is not the app itself. It is what sits behind it. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer lets agents pause and resume emails
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer lets agents pause emails while waiting for information or approvals, freeing them to handle higher-priority contacts and resume their work later. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Connect Customer prefills the email address for new threads started from cases
item.description: Amazon Connect Customer automatically fills in the customer’s email address from the linked customer profile when agents start a new email thread from a case. (1 source: aws)
